what: Add blaze-intent.workspace = true to [dependencies] of crates/blaze-lints/Cargo.toml (after blaze-diagnostics). blaze-lints builds the MachineApplicable fixes of blaze::std_lock, std_mpsc and fx_hash with blaze_intent::retarget, the resolver shared with Edit::Replace, and blaze fix applies them through blaze_intent::file::Working::splice. There is no cycle: blaze-intent does not depend on blaze-lints. Until this lands, blaze-lints code that names blaze_intent does not compile, so I hold it back.
